scope: Final exact-source packaged explicit combat fixture, six weapon variants; selected impacts, death responses and dismemberment.

binding.runtime_identity_scope: Six identities recorded and verified before/after by the bound packaged runner; this review does not repeat a build or full runtime rehash.

method.note: Full original 1600x900 JPEGs viewed individually, with adjacent samples around several discharges and the final detached head. Sparse gaps remain.

fixture_constraints: Ordinary waves are suppressed. Explicit standing targets have actor tick/movement stopped and animation poses paused; actual logical cursor/controller input, weapon discharges and collision are used.

Selected trial 6 has five aligned targets at 1 health, so its multiple kills are not normal-health lethality evidence. Trial 11 uses one declared wounded target at 25 health. Trial 8 uses a standing target at 112 health and a fixed lateral leg aim.

Scenes and presentation are cleared between trials; ammo is refilled and spread seeded. Targets can be replaced in a screenshot whose label still names the preceding trial (observed frames 231 and 915).
Scripted controller input is not a native human playtest. Ordinary combat, sustained cadence, recoil feel and long-term corpse settling are outside this review.

findings.observation: All six held forms/HUD names are readable. Pale base tracers, purple Last Word, teal Overcurrent and orange Gravebreaker traces distinguish the sampled shots. Ammo consumption, gold hit markers, local red blood and point awards are legible without hiding most of the target silhouette.
findings.limitation: This does not measure perceptual timing, continuous recoil, audio quality or normal encounter balance.

findings.observation: Adjacent impact/aftermath samples show struck bodies begin buckling. The longer shotgun aftermath shows two or three distinct bodies fold close to the floor while unaffected targets stay upright.
findings.limitation: Rapid resets prevent long-term resting/collision judgments; poses are controlled by the fixture before each shot.

findings.observation: Remington 870 frame 1581 visibly separates a leg segment with a red cut; frame 1680 shows a detached head and neck cap. Gravebreaker frames 2137/2138 show a separated head beside the red neck cap across adjacent original frames.
findings.limitation: Some pistol/rifle head-hit markers obscure the head region. No severance or exact contact quality is inferred from those obscured samples.

findings.observation: No obvious missing material, explosive mesh stretch or detached garment appears in these selected frames. All three infected garment designs appear among the fixtures.
findings.limitation: This bounded sample is not full animation/art approval and does not exclude defects in uninspected frames or ordinary crowds.
